themes.title: Right-Wing Push for Institutional and Educational Reform
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in both the United States and Sweden are mounting aggressive pushes against progressive institutional norms and educational frameworks. In Sweden, Sverigedemokraterna is demanding an overhaul of school governance following declining academic performance, while in the US, pressure from the Trump administration forced the American Bar Association to scrap its diversity accreditation requirements.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Threatened accreditor status to force the elimination of diversity and inclusion requirements in law schools.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Demanded a complete course correction in school governance toward traditional, teacher-led instruction following poor PISA results.

themes.title: Economic Protectionism and Domestic Resource Deregulation
themes.blurb: Right-leaning parties across borders are responding to persistent inflation and energy costs by advocating for tax cuts, domestic industry protections, and direct economic interventions. In Norway, Fremskrittspartiet is demanding emergency parliamentary action to slash fuel and CO2 taxes, while in the US, Donald Trump is promising direct consumer cash dividends alongside protective executive orders for domestic agriculture and energy.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Promised $5,000 voter dividends to offset inflation while advancing protective executive orders for domestic cattle, agriculture, and fuel production.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Demanded emergency parliamentary sessions to abolish fuel tax increases and cut CO2 taxes amid a nationwide cost-of-living debate.

themes.title: Right-Wing Parties Battle Electoral Rules and Funding Scrutiny
themes.blurb: Right-wing political movements are navigating legal friction and internal scrutiny regarding electoral mechanics, administrative appointments, and party governance. The Trump administration faces judicial setbacks over mail voting restrictions, redistricting maps, and federal grant allocations, while Norway's Fremskrittspartiet grapples with candidate candidacies following complaints and internal management concerns.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Faced court rejections over mail voting restrictions, struck-down redistricting maps, and legal challenges to acting attorney appointments.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Managed local electoral candidacies following resignation complaints and internal disputes over managerial control.
